evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Plain unhedged assertion of what the sample does — committed core, but no ratification language or operational rule to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule stated with modal 'must' twice — a load-bearing requirement the speaker expects to be enforced, not merely argued for.
